svg.title: Molecule of the day: Fluoxetine
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Fluoxetine while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 2.03.
svg.text: MW 309.3 · cLogP 4.44 · TPSA 21.3 · HBD 1 · HBA 2 · RotB 6
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
